attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless podman-based nginx web app on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) running as the unprivileged system account appsvc, serving on port 8080 via a Podman Quadlet-generated systemd --user unit (webapp.service) wired into appsvc's default.target. Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc so its systemd user manager (and the container) starts at boot without any active login session. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a baseline boot_id and healthy service/HTTP state, issued a backgrounded `shutdown -r now`, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual reboot), and verified post-reboot that appsvc still had zero login sessions (state=lingering), webapp.service was active, a freshly-started container was running, and curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200.
